pages: Foreground: stone steps running down to the water with a washing bat on the top one. Middle: Isa, twelve, dark hair, a mustard pinafore with bare arms, standing at the lake edge below them, looking across the water. Background: Caldmere's one street above, morning. Light: morning on the stone.

Ned Skell, eighty-one, white hair under a brown moleskin coat, sits on the landing stage with one hand lifted, a tin mug beside his knee. Middle distance: the tin mug, a coil of wet rope, the stage edge. Background: the lake below the market town, mid-morning. One warm light, long soft shadows.

Tenna Raup, sixty, grey hair under a deep green wool shawl, stands with one hand flat on an oak boundary post at the head of the common. Middle distance: a run of woven eel baskets set in the grass, coiled cord. Background: grazing land and a low ridge, March, pale sun. Light: flat cold light, her shawl the one deep note.

Mert Cauldwell, forty-one, black hair, a black frock coat and grey neckcloth, bends over the plank table with one finger resting on the open ledger. Middle distance: the open ledger, a cut reed pen, a stub of candle. Background: the account table at the water's edge, a March afternoon. Light: low sun along the plank, cold blue behind him.

Mert Cauldwell, forty-one, black frock coat with the sleeves turned back, crouches at the shingle with one hand held out flat over the water, searching the surface. Middle distance: a folded measuring rod, a trestle leg of the plank table. Background: the bank below the market town, June, low gold light. Light: warm on his shoulders, long shadow on the shingle.

Mert Cauldwell, forty-one, a dark brown travelling coat, hat in his hand, kneels on the wet shingle in first light with his face close to the water. Middle distance: an upturned fish basket, a coil of line on the stones. Background: the lake before the market stalls are up, cold dawn. Light: thin blue dawn, one low warm edge on the water.

Silla Norn, thirty-eight, brown hair, a plum wool gown and white apron, stands at the shallow stones looking down at the water with both hands on a copper churn lid. Middle distance: the copper churn, a hoop of white cloth on the stones. Background: the far end of the lake in midsummer, high noon. Light: hard bright sun, short shadow under her brim.

Mert Cauldwell, forty-one, black frock coat, stands at the plank table with a cut reed pen held above the open ledger, looking up from the water. Middle distance: the open ledger, an inkhorn, the table's plank edge. Background: the market square at the lake foot, an August morning. Light: warm flat sun, hard shadow under the table.

Gert Herrow, fifty-four, grey hair, a green wool skirt and starched apron, looks down into the water at the market steps with a coin flat on her open palm. Middle distance: a folded cloth purse, the wet upper step. Background: the market square by the lake, a Friday in August. Light: warm low sun striking the coin.

Isa, twelve, a girl in a mustard pinafore, stands on the broken stones at the far end of the lake with a pail at her feet, watching the chop. Middle distance: the pail on the stones, a wet sheet spread flat on the rock. Background: the far shore and standing reeds, late summer afternoon. Light: warm on her shoulders, cold blue on the chop.

Isa, twelve, a girl in a mustard pinafore, kneels behind the pound with a stone washing bowl in both hands, staring into the water in it. Middle distance: the bowl with a grey head surfacing in the still water, a wet sheet over the tub. Background: the pound wall and the back lane, mid-morning. Light: warm sun on the bowl, deep blue shade behind.

Isa, twelve, a girl in a mustard pinafore, stands at the plank table with both palms flat on the boards either side of the stone bowl. Middle distance: the stone washing bowl, the open ledger, a market scale. Background: the square below the one street, a Friday at noon. Light: high sun, the pale bowl bright against the oak.

Isa, twelve, a girl in a blue-grey wool coat, stands on a swept earth doorstep with the stone washing bowl balanced on her forearm. Middle distance: the stone bowl, a stack of woven eel baskets by the door. Background: a low thatched cottage at the far end of the lake, late afternoon. Light: warm low sun along the wall, blue eaves shade.

Ned Skell, eighty-one, white hair, a brown moleskin coat, stands square in the market square with one hand held out flat, refusing the bargain. Middle distance: a hazel wand, a heavy iron key, the pound wall behind. Background: the market square, October, low grey light. Light: flat overcast, warm on his weathered face.

Isa, twelve, a girl in a rust-red wool coat, stands in the wash yard at the washing steps with one hand on the rim of the wooden tub, speaking out loud. Middle distance: the wash tub, a wet sheet on the line. Background: the stone steps and the yard, a bright cold afternoon. Light: flat sun on the wet linen, blue shade on the wall.

Isa, twelve, a girl in a rust-red wool coat, stands knee-deep on the shallow stones with her chin lifted and her wet hands open at her sides. Middle distance: her own sunburnt face lying flat in the still water, a wooden pail on the stone. Background: the far end of the lake, low gold late light. Light: warm on her shoulders, long blue shadow behind.

Isa, twelve, a girl in a rust-red wool coat, stands by the pound wall with her arms folded, looking across the square at the plank table. Middle distance: a crate of eels at the table's foot, the open ledger on the plank. Background: the market square at the lake foot, the ninth of October, flat cold morning. Light: flat white daylight, long grey shadow.

Mert Cauldwell, forty-two, black hair, a black frock coat, stands at the plank table with one finger on the open ledger and his head up, speaking. Middle distance: the open ledger, an inkhorn, a cut reed pen laid down. Background: the market square by the pound, flat cold daylight. Light: cold white sun, his shadow long on the boards.

Tenna Raup, sixty-one, grey hair, a rust-red wool shawl over a grey gown, comes up the bank to the plank table with one hand flat on the boards. Middle distance: the open ledger, the stone washing bowl set beside it. Background: the bank and the market square, hard cold daylight. Light: cold sun, the shawl the only warm colour.

Mert Cauldwell, forty-two, unshaven and wet, in a black frock coat, crouches at the pound wall with his face turned square to the water. Middle distance: a stub of a boundary marker post, a wet stone ledge. Background: the pound and the flat grey lake beyond, cold October noon. Light: flat white light, the whole sky lying on the water.

A woman of about fifty, brown hair under a red kerchief, in a plain grey wool gown, carries the stone washing bowl out on both hands at a cottage door. Middle distance: the stone bowl, a bundle of white linen on the step. Background: Caldmere's one street, a November morning. Light: thin low sun, long shadow down the street.

Tenna Raup, sixty-one, grey hair, a blue-grey wool coat, stands on the washing steps with one hand flat on the iron-grey water. Middle distance: a woven eel basket set on the stone, a folded wet sheet. Background: the far end of the lake, November dusk, dead reeds. Light: low blue dusk, a thin warm bar from the cottage window.
